title: A nontrivial unit automorphism obstructs a universal right-unit claim
statement: Fix l,X,R,closed,models,symmetry with the native realization and residue-prime hypotheses, and a CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit datum data [new-sf-adic-completed-tensor-common-lift-tensor-unit]. Suppose e is an automorphism of closed.monoidal.tensorUnit with e.hom different from the identity. Then it is false that every CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit datum d satisfies closed.tensor(id,d.unit.hom) followed by d.tensor at (A,commonUnit) and ordinary of the common right unitor equals the native right unitor, for all A.

proof.text: Keep data.tensor fixed and replace data.unit by e followed by data.unit. Apply the putative universal law to both data records at the common coefficient unit.

The new normalization theorem gives a unique unit comparison satisfying the equation at the common coefficient unit for the fixed tensorator. Apply uniqueness to data.unit and the twisted unit; the putative universal law supplies both equations. Thus the unit isomorphisms, and hence their homs, agree.
Cancel the invertible data.unit.hom. This says e.hom is the identity, contradicting the explicit hypothesis. The empty scheme is not excluded: it may simply admit no such e.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_right_unit_not_universal
    (data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry)
    (e : closed.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅ closed.monoidal.tensorUnit)
    (he : e.hom ≠ 𝟙 _) :
    ¬ (∀ d : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry,
      ∀ A : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X,
        closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) d.unit.hom) ≫
            d.tensor.hom.app (A, pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X) ≫
            (ordinary l X R).map
              (pullbackTensorCommonRightUnitor l (PadicAlgCl l) X A).hom =
          (closed.monoidal.rightUnitor ((ordinary l X R).obj A)).hom)
